# Gorilla — animation 6

The six-pose transparent silverback sheet was created with built-in imagegen on October 19, 2026 and saved as gorilla6.png. Local Canvas effects supply the chest-beat rhythm, the ground-slam shockwave, dust and the defeated king's fall. The ending holds only the gorilla. The shared animations setting and original confetti behavior are retained, together with reduced motion and cancellation.
